analysis: post hoc designated-category scoring on single-convention-focused transcripts
input: unaltered Stage 3 V5 model responses and author-reviewed reference keys
unit: exact-match annotated tokens matched as multisets within utterances
scope: only morpheme codes in each transcript's designated target convention
disclaimer: The original all-category single transcript scores were 99.68% (Sol) and 97.02% (Gemini). These target-category counts were computed after the original evaluation; they are not a prespecified metric nor new model-inference runs. Do not combine with mixed-convention all-category F1 into an aggregate F1.
